answer: Require each answer to be attested by a quorum of peers who share no referral edge with its author — no kin links in the invite graph. A swarm of fakes minted by one operator forms a dense copper web of mutual vouching, so cross-grading among them is forbidden and buys nothing. Finality must come from outside that cluster, as solid and foreign as basalt. One real contributor flitting in like a sparrow to confirm honest work counts for more than a thousand siblings grading each other.
